inputs.title: HST/NICMOS Paschen-α Survey of the Galactic Centre: the Paschen-α line map, about Sgr A*
inputs.credit: NASA, ESA, Q. D. Wang (University of Massachusetts, Amherst) and the HST/NICMOS Paschen-α Survey of the Galactic Centre (Wang et al. 2010; Dong et al. 2011), from MAST
inputs.acquisition: Built by the generator (`node packages/bake/authoring/galactic-centre/paschen-alpha.mts <rows directory> src/objects/galactic-centre-layers/source`) from two byte ranges of hlsp_hpsgc_hst_nicmos-nic3_gc_palpha_v1_img.fits (842,405,760 bytes; the whole mosaic is not fetched): its header, bytes 0 to 5759, and rows 2501 to 3586 of its 23,400 × 9,000 pixels, bytes 234099360 to 335748959 (101,649,600 bytes), which are 55 arcsec either side of Sgr A*. The rows are resampled onto a north-up square of 1101 px, 0.1 arcsec a pixel, and given display color: black at 4 µJy a pixel, an inverse hyperbolic sine about 6, full at 220, through matplotlib's afmhot ramp. Restored from the source cache; not tracked. A display picture of a calibrated line map, not the map's values.
inputs.license: Public NASA mission data (MAST); retain the recorded credit.
